Grace and Hope Special School is a public special-needs school in Seshego Zone 1, Polokwane, serving learners who need additional support in their education. The school carries a national EMIS number and operates as a Section 21 school, which means its governing body has a degree of self-reliance over its budget. Around 517 learners are enrolled, taught by 32 teachers, with classes kept at roughly 15 to 20 learners each.

Because it is a public institution, the school does not charge school fees, which keeps its specialised education accessible to families across Seshego and the surrounding area. Parents searching for a special-needs school with small classes will find the 15-to-20 ratio a useful starting point when comparing options. The school is located on Zone 1 in Seshego, Polokwane, in Limpopo.

Inkrite is a printer cartridge specialist trading from Palm Centre in Moregloed, Polokwane, focused on keeping office and home printers running without the cost of buying new cartridges. The business offers ink and toner cartridge refills along with cartridge refurbishment, so customers can bring in an empty cartridge and have it restored rather than replaced, and it also carries related cartridge supplies.

This kind of refill-and-refurbish service suits households and small offices that go through cartridges regularly and want a cheaper alternative to new stock. Inkrite is based at Shop 8, Palm Centre, Grobler Street, Moregloed, Polokwane, making it a convenient stop for anyone in the area needing a cartridge refilled, refurbished or replaced.

IV-Med Pharmacy is a community pharmacy on Campbell Street in Ivy Park, Polokwane, providing dispensing services and everyday healthcare products to residents of the surrounding area. The pharmacy is registered as a retail pharmacy on the Medpages healthcare provider database, and its own Facebook page describes it simply as a community pharmacy based in Polokwane.

As a neighbourhood pharmacy, it serves customers needing prescription medicine, over-the-counter treatments and general health supplies without having to travel into central Polokwane for a dispensary. IV-Med Pharmacy keeps regular trading hours that include Sunday opening, which suits households needing a pharmacy outside the usual weekday run, and is located at 34 Campbell Street, Ivy Park, Polokwane.

Iynesab Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy on Munnik Avenue in Sterpark, Polokwane, offering prescription dispensing alongside wellness products and general health support for the local community. According to the pharmacy's own website, the business focuses on everyday pharmacy needs, combining prescription assistance with a range of health and wellness stock for patients who want more than a basic dispensary visit.

As an independent operator rather than a franchise store, it serves residents of Sterpark and the surrounding suburbs who need a nearby pharmacy for both prescription medicine and general wellness products. Iynesab Pharmacy is based at 3 Munnik Avenue, Sterpark, and is open on weekdays from 8am to 9pm and on Saturdays from 8am to 5pm, closed on Sundays.

KFC Seshego Circle is a branch of the KFC fast-food chain on Ditlou Street in Seshego, specialising in chicken meals such as fried chicken and wings. The branch offers a takeaway service for customers who want their order on the go, alongside the usual KFC quick-service counter for those eating in.

It operates daily, giving residents of Seshego a nearby option for fried chicken and quick-service meals without travelling into central Polokwane. The branch suits customers after a quick lunch or dinner, or a takeaway order to bring home, and trades from the corner of Ditlou Street and 27th Avenue in Seshego-B.

Ladanna Med is a multi-specialty medical centre on Pietersburg Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, bringing several healthcare services under one roof. The practice offers primary healthcare and family medicine from its general practitioners, with separate dentistry and optometry services for patients who want a check-up in the same place. Appointments can be booked through the website, or patients can call the centre directly.

The centre sets itself apart with extended weekday hours, open until 8pm from Monday to Friday, and weekend opening from 9am to 5pm on Saturdays and Sundays. Weekend appointments are available with the dental team, which suits working families who cannot attend during office hours. Its Ladanna address makes it a convenient option for residents of the surrounding area, and it suits anyone who wants general checkups, dental care and eye tests from one practice.

Master Tech Auto Services is an automotive repair and vehicle maintenance workshop in Superbia, Polokwane, listed in the Auto Repair Directory under the name Master Tech Workshop. The business handles mechanical repair work and general vehicle maintenance for cars brought in by local motorists, operating from its own premises rather than a franchised dealership service centre.

It serves vehicle owners in and around Superbia who need a workshop for routine servicing or repair work closer to home. Master Tech Auto Services is based at 40 Tungsten Street, Superbia, Polokwane, making it a convenient option for customers in the Polokwane Extension 13 area who need their vehicle looked at locally.

Medpark Family Practice is a general-practitioner and family healthcare practice in Polokwane, offering family medicine and primary healthcare from its team of general practitioners. It operates as a group medical practice under the Medpark name, with its own website and Facebook page where patients can find more about the service and its doctors.

The practice serves patients seeking everyday medical care, from check-ups and minor ailments to ongoing family healthcare, in a group setting rather than a single-doctor consulting room. Medpark Family Practice is based at 24A Jorissen Street, Polokwane Central, giving CBD residents and workers a nearby practice for general medical needs.

Mini Pet Land is a pet store on Plot 27 in Dalmada, on the outskirts of Polokwane, supplying pet owners in the area with everyday pet-related products. Trading from a plot address rather than a shopping centre unit, it sits among the smallholdings and plots on the edge of the city rather than in a typical retail strip.

It serves pet owners living on the surrounding plots and smallholdings around Dalmada who would otherwise have to travel further into Polokwane for pet supplies. Mini Pet Land is located at Plot 27, Dalmada, Polokwane, giving residents of the area a local option for their pet-related needs.

Mochachos Nirvana is a branch of the Mochachos chicken restaurant chain, serving flame-grilled, Mexican-spiced chicken and takeaway meals from Tagore Street in Nirvana, Polokwane. The Mochachos brand traces back to its first store, opened in Pretoria in 1994, and its menu built around flame-grilled chicken has since grown to include burgers, wraps and other Mexican-inspired dishes alongside the core chicken offering.

The Nirvana branch gives local customers a nearby option for a prepared chicken meal or a takeaway order without travelling further into Polokwane. Mochachos Nirvana is confirmed, via the brand's own store page, to trade from 10C Tagore Street in Nirvana, making it a convenient stop for residents of the suburb wanting flame-grilled chicken.

Molepo Dental Practice Inc is a dental practice at Turfloop Medical Centre in Mankweng, providing general dentistry services to patients from the surrounding community. The practice is listed on the Medpages healthcare provider database as a dentistry practice in Mankweng, and appears on the GEMS medical scheme's network list of accredited dental providers for the Limpopo region.

Being part of a recognised medical scheme network gives GEMS members a dentist they can visit using their cover, alongside general dental patients from the area. Molepo Dental Practice Inc is based at Shop 2B, Turfloop Medical Centre in Mankweng-F, serving dental patients from Mankweng and the surrounding community.

Mponegele Primary School is a public primary school in Seshego Zone 1, Polokwane, registered with the national EMIS number 922221104 and listed as a Quintile 4 school with an open status on the Schools4SA education register. It operates in the primary school phase, covering foundation and intermediate phase education for learners drawn from the surrounding Seshego community.

As a public, Quintile 4 institution, the school falls under the government's school-fee funding bands rather than charging full private fees, which keeps it accessible to families in the area. Mponegele Primary School is located at 1 Zone 1, Seshego-A, Seshego, Polokwane, serving primary school learners from Seshego Zone 1 and the wider neighbourhood.

Mr Price Seshego Circle is a branch of the Mr Price clothing chain, trading from Shop 25 in Seshego Circle on Ditlou Street, Seshego. The branch is listed on Mr Price's own store locator, which confirms it as an active store within the national value-fashion retailer's network of outlets.

Mr Price positions itself around affordable, trend-led fashion for everyday wear, and the Seshego Circle branch gives shoppers in Seshego a nearby option for clothing without needing to travel into central Polokwane. The store is a practical stop for customers after everyday and value-priced fashion basics, and its location inside Seshego Circle puts it alongside the shopping centre's other retailers on Ditlou Street.

Nando's Savannah Mall is a flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken restaurant inside Savannah Mall in Fauna Park, Polokwane, offering both dine-in seating and collection for customers who prefer to take their order to go. The branch is confirmed on Nando's own store locator as trading from Shop 71, reached through Entrance 4 of Savannah Mall.

The menu follows the chain's Portuguese-inspired approach built around flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken, giving Fauna Park shoppers a sit-down or takeaway option without leaving the mall. Nando's Savannah Mall suits shoppers wanting a meal during a visit to Savannah Mall, as well as customers collecting a takeaway order on their way through Fauna Park.

Nkondo Attorneys is a law firm in Polokwane Central providing legal services to clients across the city. The practice appears on legal directories covering firms in the Polokwane area, including a dedicated profile that names it among the city's practising attorneys, and it maintains its own website for client contact.

As a general legal practice, it serves clients requiring legal assistance for matters that need a qualified attorney's involvement, rather than clients searching for a single narrow specialisation. Nkondo Attorneys is based at 28 Schoeman Street, Polokwane Central, giving clients in and around the CBD a nearby firm to consult for legal services.

PEP Cell Mankweng Paledi Mall is a branch of the PEP Cell mobile retail chain, trading from Shop 43 inside Paledi Mall in Mankweng. PEP Cell operates as the cellular-focused arm of the PEP retail group, offering mobile phones, airtime, data and related cellular products and services from its store counters.

The Paledi Mall branch gives shoppers around Mankweng a local option for cellular products without needing to travel further into Polokwane for a PEP Cell store. PEP Cell Mankweng Paledi Mall is located at Shop 43, Paledi Mall, Mankweng, serving customers looking for mobile phones, airtime and related cellular products and services.

PEP Stores at Checkers Centre is a branch of the national PEP value-retail chain, trading from Shop 5 inside Checkers Centre in Polokwane Central. The store sells affordable clothing, footwear and other everyday retail merchandise, in keeping with PEP's long-standing position as a budget-focused retailer aimed at value-conscious shoppers rather than higher-end fashion buyers.

It serves local shoppers in the CBD who are looking for affordable retail products rather than higher-priced fashion chains, making it a practical stop for everyday clothing, footwear and household basics picked up in one trip. PEP Stores Checkers Centre is located at Shop 5, Checkers Centre, 61 Hans van Rensburg Street, Polokwane Central, within easy reach of other CBD shops.

Polokwane Truck And Car is a vehicle workshop in Futura, Polokwane, handling truck and car repair, vehicle diagnostics and engine rebuilding for commercial and passenger vehicles. The business also sells and rents out forklifts, extending its services beyond general vehicle repair to material-handling equipment for business customers.

Alongside its workshop services, it offers breakdown assistance and operates on a 24-hour basis, so vehicle owners can call on it outside normal working hours. Polokwane Truck And Car serves car, truck and commercial-vehicle owners as well as businesses needing forklift sales or rental, and is based at 38 Emerald Street, Futura, Polokwane.

Rakoma Travel is a corporate travel agency in Bendor, Polokwane, part of the Rakoma Group and based at Rhodesdrift Office Park. The agency arranges business flights, accommodation and bookings that follow a client's travel policy. It also designs trips for corporate retreats and government conferences, as well as leisure holidays, and each journey is tailored to the client's needs.

The company says it has served more than 400 clients and highlights transparent pricing, flexible travel packages and expert travel guides. Its team tracks travel trends and border regulations so that advice on routes and documentation stays current, which matters for travellers heading abroad. Rakoma Travel suits companies that need one agency to handle group bookings, and it also helps individuals plan everything from local trips to international escapes.

Review Printers is a printing, copying and signage business based in Superbia, Polokwane, producing printed materials and signage for both private customers and local organisations. The business handles everyday print and copy work for households and offices, along with signage production for businesses wanting on-site visibility.

It serves individuals and organisations across Polokwane who require printing services, from small personal print jobs to larger signage and copying orders for an office or event. Review Printers is located at 42 Graniet Street in Superbia, within the Polokwane Ext 13 area, and is a practical stop for anyone needing printing, photocopying or signage work completed locally.

Seshego Zone 1 Clinic is a primary healthcare clinic on 7th Street in Seshego, providing everyday medical care to residents who need consultations, treatment and basic health services close to home. As a primary healthcare facility, it forms part of the public clinic network that Seshego and the surrounding Polokwane communities rely on for day-to-day healthcare needs.

The clinic serves residents of Seshego and the wider surrounding community who need accessible primary healthcare without travelling into central Polokwane. It keeps extended hours, open from 8am to 8pm every day of the week, giving patients more flexibility than a typical weekday-only clinic. Seshego Zone 1 Clinic is located at 824 7th Street in Seshego, a convenient option for anyone in the area needing routine or urgent primary care.

Shell Bendor Service Station is a Shell-branded fuel station on De Wet Drive in Bendor Park, Polokwane, with a 24-hour fuel service. It sells Shell V-Power 95, Shell V-Power Diesel (50ppm), Shell Unleaded 93 and Shell Diesel Extra, and motorists can pay at the pump or with credit and fleet cards. The forecourt also has a car wash, a toilet, air and vacuum facilities, and a Select shop.

Food options include a bakery counter and fast food, and the station offers BBQ propane cylinder exchange for households and campers. Shell's station listing notes disabled facilities and assistance for customers, which makes it easier for every driver to use the forecourt. It is a practical refuelling stop for motorists in Bendor Park at any hour.

Shell Sediba Service Station is a Shell-branded fuel station on the corner of Grobler Street and Webster Road in Moregloed, Polokwane, supplying Shell petrol and diesel around the clock. The forecourt runs a 24-hour fuel service, so motorists can fill up at any hour, with quick-lube and service bays on site for routine vehicle maintenance.

Alongside fuel, the station houses a Spar Express convenience store for everyday groceries and snacks, a bakery shop, a car wash and an ATM, making it a stop for more than just petrol. It serves private motorists, commercial drivers and anyone travelling through Moregloed who needs fuel, a quick grocery top-up or forecourt services such as a wash and lube. Shell Sediba Service Station is a practical, round-the-clock stop in Moregloed, Polokwane.

Steers at the Engen Greycorp Convenience Centre on Grobler Street is a branch of the flame-grilled burger and chicken chain, serving burgers, chicken, hand-cut chips, thick shakes and pork-loin ribs. The menu covers the chain's full flame-grilled range, prepared to order for customers who want a quick meal without giving up flame-grilled flavour.

The branch offers dine-in, takeaway and delivery, and runs a 24-hour service from the forecourt, so customers passing through central Polokwane can get a meal at any time of day or night. It serves motorists refuelling at the Engen station as well as customers heading into the CBD for a meal. Steers is located at the Engen Greycorp Convenience Centre, 8 Grobler Street, Polokwane Central, a handy stop for quick-service burgers at any hour.

Tens Automotive's Polokwane branch is a vehicle workshop at 44 Gypsum Street in Nirvana, part of a group with branches in Pretoria, East London, Mpumalanga and Thohoyandou. The workshop handles mechanical and service work, and it lists warranty repairs under the AA Warranty as well as RT46 government work among its services. Customers can request a free quote through the branch website before bringing a vehicle in.

The business is MIWA-accredited, and MIWA is the Motor Industry Workshop Association, which sets workshop standards for its members. The branch offers bumper-to-bumper servicing with online booking, so drivers can plan a visit in advance. A customer lounge gives clients a place to wait while their vehicle is being attended to.

The Biggest Grill is a spit-braai, barbecue and South African-style food catering business based in Penina Park, Polokwane, preparing braai and barbecue meals for private customers as well as catering and event clients. Its menu draws on South African braai traditions, offering flame-cooked and barbecue dishes prepared for groups, functions and everyday orders.

The business grew out of home cooking into a full catering venture, and local reporting has highlighted its community involvement alongside its food. It suits private customers wanting a braai-style meal as well as event organisers and businesses looking for catering with a South African flavour. The Biggest Grill operates from 11 Letaba Avenue in Penina Park, serving customers across Polokwane who want spit-braai, barbecue and South African food, whether for a private order or a larger catering event.

Uhuru Cafe & Wine Emporium is a contemporary and Mediterranean-inspired restaurant at 42 Grobler Street in Sterpark, Polokwane, serving breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner. The venue is listed as fine dining with a full bar, and its wine list is noted as a highlight. It hosts Sunday brunch and live entertainment, reservations are recommended, and the dress code is casual elegant.

Guests can eat indoors or in the outdoor seating area, and the menu includes healthy options as well as takeaway. The cafe suits a range of occasions, from family meals with children and romantic dinners to business lunches and quick drinks. Facilities include free Wi-Fi, wheelchair access and street and car park parking, and the major card networks are accepted.

It serves customers in Bendor Park and the surrounding area who are looking for Chinese food and sushi to take away, whether for a quick weekday meal or a weekend order. Based inside Platinum Park Shopping Centre, the restaurant is a convenient stop for shoppers and residents passing through the centre who want a takeaway meal without a sit-down wait.

items.description:
MRA Insurance Brokers Limpopo is the Polokwane office of MRA Insurance Brokers, an independent brokerage formerly known as Commrisk. The group describes itself as the largest independent insurance broker in Mpumalanga and has branches in Nelspruit, White River and Polokwane. It offers a full range of personal, commercial and agricultural insurance, along with specialised products for clients whose cover needs differ from the usual.

Business insurance is tailored to each client's circumstances, and the brokerage also handles claims, legal and compliance matters through its MRA Assist service. It represents all the major insurers and is the only appointed Hollard Select Broker in Mpumalanga, which gives clients access to a wide choice of cover. The Polokwane office is on Pierre Street in Bendor, serving households and businesses in the city.

MRC Welding is a welding and steel fabrication business in Futura, Polokwane, working with structural steel, aluminium and custom fabrication. Its directory profile lists it as a welder, steel fabricator and steel construction company, and it also lists solar energy among its industries. Services include structural steel welding, custom fabrication and welding carried out on site, so clients do not always need to bring their work to the workshop.

The business is based at 61 Koper Street in Futura, and its listing gives trading hours of Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, with the business closed at weekends. That schedule suits contractors and businesses that need steelwork done during the working week. The shop is a practical option for anyone in Polokwane who needs welding for a building, a vehicle or an industrial job.

Ndzalama Training is an accredited education and skills development provider with a Polokwane office on Platinum Street in Ladanna, operating since 2002. The organisation runs assessor, moderator and facilitator training, as well as skills development facilitation, coaching and mentoring courses. It also offers the ODETP National Certificate and a course on designing and developing learning material.

The provider helps organisations become accredited training providers and lists services for registering a TVET college, along with quality management system development. Its courses are SETA-accredited and are aimed at people who need a recognised qualification or a formal assessor and moderator credential. Visitors to the Polokwane office can find the full course list and contact details on the organisation's contact page.

Ocean Basket Mall of the North is a branch of the Ocean Basket seafood restaurant chain, inside Mall of the North on the R81 in Bendor, Polokwane. The menu centres on seafood sharing platters, crispy hake, grilled calamari and freshly prepared sushi, with family favourites and generous portions. The restaurant describes itself as a place to bring people together over good food.

Customers can also order through Uber Eats or MrD delivery, and the branch is part of the chain's rewards and promotions programme. The restaurant sits in the Mall of the North complex, a convenient stop for shoppers in Bendor who want a sit-down seafood meal. Opening hours are Monday to Friday from 11am to 9:30pm, Saturday until 10pm and Sunday until 8pm.
